rules.name: high: frontier model release
rules.note: A named frontier model plus a shipping verb, in the same line. The verb can come first (\"OpenAI announces GPT-5\") or second (\"GPT-5 is here\"), which is why the pattern is written both ways round.

rules.name: high: open weights
rules.note: Open weights are the most actionable thing in the feed: you can run them.

rules.name: high: safety and evaluation landmarks
rules.note: System cards and the evaluation vocabulary labs only use when they are publishing something real.
rules.query: \b(system card|model card|safety (framework|case|report)|preparedness framework|responsible scaling|frontier safety|red[- ]?team(ing)?|interpretability|scheming|sandbagging|deceptive alignment|dangerous capabilit(y|ies))\b

rules.name: high: regulation with teeth
rules.note: Not policy chatter — the moments something becomes binding: an act, an order, a court, a fine.

rules.name: high: billion-scale money
rules.note: Both halves are required: a number that size on its own is usually quarterly revenue, which is noise.

rules.name: high: capability milestone
rules.note: Claims that a ceiling moved. Rare in a headline unless it actually happened.

rules.name: high: compute, chips and supply
rules.note: The physical constraint everything else runs into. A named accelerator counts on its own; a data centre only counts at billion scale, and the money can be written on either side of it.

rules.name: high: leadership shake-up
rules.note: Who runs a frontier lab decides what it ships. Needs both a role and a departure — a company name alone is not enough.
rules.query: \b(ceo|cto|co-?founder|founder|chief scientist|head of (research|alignment|safety)|board)\b.*\b(steps down|stepped down|resign(s|ed)?|fired|ousted|departs?|is leaving|joins)\b|\b(steps down|resign(s|ed)?|fired|ousted) as (ceo|cto|chief scientist)\b

rules.name: high: security incident
rules.note: Real incidents only — \"jailbreak\" is deliberately absent, there is a paper about one every week.
rules.query: \b(data breach|breached|leaked (weights|model|system prompt|source code)|(weights|model|system prompt|source code|credentials?) (were )?leaked|zero[- ]day|cve-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+|supply[- ]chain attack|exfiltrat(e|ed|ion)|credentials? (leak|stolen))\b
